question: In MS PowerPoint, which of the following keys must be pressed to start a new line while typing inside a text box?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Enter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In MS PowerPoint, pressing **Enter** within a text box creates a new line.
 
• The **Enter key** is used to break the text into multiple lines while typing inside a text box.
 
• This functionality is essential for structuring text content such as bullet points, paragraphs, or headings within the slide.
 
• Other keys like **Shift**, **Tab**, or **Spacebar** have different functions and cannot create a new line.
 
• The **Enter key** works universally across different versions of MS PowerPoint for this purpose.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Text Box:** A container in PowerPoint used to input and format text independently of slide layouts.
 
• **Shift + Enter:** In some applications, this combination creates a line break without starting a new paragraph, but it is not required in PowerPoint text boxes.
 
• **Tab Key:** Used to increase or decrease the indent of text in bulleted or numbered lists in PowerPoint.
 
• **Shortcut Keys in PowerPoint:** PowerPoint offers a range of shortcuts for text formatting, navigation, and slide management to enhance productivity.
 
• **Formatting Text:** Besides creating new lines, users can apply font styles, sizes, and colors to text to improve the visual appeal of their presentations.
